about: Hand decisions about ME3 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing (scripts/msh/gridbooks.py reads this book). Every one was read off the page image; none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and a few words of a label - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.

match     {page, header}: the printed page in the entry's own booklet, and the start of the entry's header; codes, the seven rank codes, where one entry prints two grids on the page (Dormammu's, Resource p.12)
{summary}: a Pregenerated Heroes Summary row (PDF 53), by the name the chart prints
verdict   as_printed        the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, and the note says why
summary_misprint  the chart prints a value its own ranks contradict and the character's block does not; 'printed' is the chart's, 'corrected' the block's
label             a grid the page sets with no header of its own, labelled as the note says
checked   the date the page image was read

A number inside its rank's range but not its standard (Pluto's 250 Shift Y, Resource p.8) needs no override: the registry's rank_ranges (scripts/msh/books.json, the me3 entry) has the check take the range for this book alone (survey decision 3, apps/marvel-heroes/docs/surveys/me3.md).

overrides.note: Printed Karma: Unlim. (survey me3.md decision 4), as ME2's Death prints Unlimited.
Printed Health: 1275*, the asterisk keying the note under the grid (survey me3.md item 12); the number adds up.

overrides.label: DORMAMMU (w/Galactus)
overrides.note: His second grid prints no header: the prose above it gives it as his figures while he controls Galactus. Labelled as Mephisto's second grid is headed, MEPHISTO (w/Galactus), p.6 (survey me3.md decision 5).
The chart's own row gives R 30 + I 50 + P 30 = 110, and Firelord's block (Adventure p.4) prints 110. ME1's and ME2's charts have the same misprint (survey me3.md decision 4).
